bf0db0a0f7792554a17ad9a0e889460991bfdbf1.name: Tool Result: Device Hook Spawn Failed
bf0db0a0f7792554a17ad9a0e889460991bfdbf1.desc: PreToolUse deny reason from Ln() when the hook command could not be started on the attached machine.

2cfed07fd596eb7d8fa31f874b440718af9890cf.name: Tool Result: Device Hook In Reach Unmarked
2cfed07fd596eb7d8fa31f874b440718af9890cf.desc: PreToolUse deny reason when a device hook file sits in a cloud-writable path and is not marked cloud: "device".

689cc5e86a7a75c6700ec3eb1e9245355e603647.name: Tool Result: Device Hook Unpinned In Reach
689cc5e86a7a75c6700ec3eb1e9245355e603647.desc: PreToolUse deny reason when an unpinned hook file sits where the cloud session can write.

03bd399d8dfec8a8eebd495cc6904d73a0ada39a.name: Tool Result: Device Hook In Reach Unmarked Move
03bd399d8dfec8a8eebd495cc6904d73a0ada39a.desc: Pinned-path PreToolUse deny reason for an in-reach hook not marked cloud: "device", telling the model to move it under ~/.claude or mark the entry.

471fe76468fe164e3833ed128f3d9af39b0b54dc.name: Tool Result: Device Hook Changed Since Registered
471fe76468fe164e3833ed128f3d9af39b0b54dc.desc: PreToolUse deny reason when the hook file changed on the attached machine since it was registered.

6abef07caf7bdcb41b7d4e5b1d1b14539714204b.name: Tool Result: Device Hook Changed While Writable
6abef07caf7bdcb41b7d4e5b1d1b14539714204b.desc: PreToolUse deny reason when the hook file changed while the cloud session could write to it.

9a5500a4374c5468686eafbb86763b524a715075.name: Tool Result: Device Hook Relocated Or Multiply Linked
9a5500a4374c5468686eafbb86763b524a715075.desc: PreToolUse deny reason when the hook path now has extra hard links or points at a different file than was registered.

fd72484e242ea9654f071c32f2ba472876c97ca4.name: Tool Result: Device Hook File Unreadable
fd72484e242ea9654f071c32f2ba472876c97ca4.desc: PreToolUse deny reason when the registered hook file can no longer be read on the attached machine.

61ba09881d0509b9e5eb0fdcb80ed28034eb4623.name: Tool Result: Device Hook Unsupported Kind
61ba09881d0509b9e5eb0fdcb80ed28034eb4623.desc: PreToolUse deny reason when the hook is not a command or http hook the attached machine can run for a cloud session.

56d82f91516e700e1d732e6a4b4c2591d18a5abe.name: Tool Result: Device Hook Stale Deadline
56d82f91516e700e1d732e6a4b4c2591d18a5abe.desc: PreToolUse deny reason when the hook request reached the attached machine already past its deadline.

d3f00f86df0b95f72cca0dab96274a9ed966cd1d.name: Tool Result: Device Hook Invalid Event
d3f00f86df0b95f72cca0dab96274a9ed966cd1d.desc: PreToolUse deny reason when the hook event payload could not be parsed on the attached machine.

98b79027fa7850cc3e57c550cdbdf2e8a9d4d344.name: Tool Result: Device Hook Event Name Mismatch
98b79027fa7850cc3e57c550cdbdf2e8a9d4d344.desc: PreToolUse deny reason when hook_event_name does not match the hook being run.

fc56f2faed6762c8f1e428e816614d3f04b45ed2.name: Tool Result: Device Hook Roots Unknown
fc56f2faed6762c8f1e428e816614d3f04b45ed2.desc: PreToolUse deny reason when the attached machine does not yet know the cloud session's directories.

301fe01987ed3f34f164075f51f1b41334f0b277.name: Tool Result: Device Hook Cloud Only File
301fe01987ed3f34f164075f51f1b41334f0b277.desc: PreToolUse deny reason when the event names a file that exists only in the cloud, so the attached machine could not judge it.

755999bb428cc713a1954908c401be2c25508033.name: Tool Result: Device Hook Unmapped Path
755999bb428cc713a1954908c401be2c25508033.desc: PreToolUse deny reason when the event names a path the attached machine could not map onto its own files.

f846d3ad5f81d802972d25de6a2a87587c709ae4.name: Tool Result: Device Hook Condition Unevaluable
f846d3ad5f81d802972d25de6a2a87587c709ae4.desc: PreToolUse deny reason when the hook's if-condition could not be evaluated on the attached machine.

4c8d9c303bc5ccacd74bb3f8f7c4a7b79ff04831.name: Tool Result: Device Hook Deadline Too Soon
4c8d9c303bc5ccacd74bb3f8f7c4a7b79ff04831.desc: PreToolUse deny reason when too little time remains before the cloud session stops waiting.

551365da574fe284cf736d77592d94d456b1854d.name: Tool Result: Device Hook Overloaded
551365da574fe284cf736d77592d94d456b1854d.desc: PreToolUse deny reason when the attached machine is already running too many cloud-session hooks.

79705c9564d9405b28107e1cab6e279af9dbe706.name: Tool Result: Device Hook Path Left Project
79705c9564d9405b28107e1cab6e279af9dbe706.desc: PreToolUse deny reason when a path named by the event moved outside the project while the hook waited for a slot.

55edbec467a4c465548e3e9bb8ab85530f89f819.name: Tool Result: Device Hook Timed Out Incomplete
55edbec467a4c465548e3e9bb8ab85530f89f819.desc: PreToolUse deny reason when the hook was aborted because too little time remained before the cloud session stopped waiting.

0ec9bb40a868634c5ee57e2323b53d6aab48a80e.name: Tool Result: Device Hook Request Id Reused
0ec9bb40a868634c5ee57e2323b53d6aab48a80e.desc: PreToolUse deny reason when a request id was already used for a different hook callback.

6d65894420b2a316adb287a85eb1fdf969e7f601.name: Tool Result: Device Hook Registration Replaced
6d65894420b2a316adb287a85eb1fdf969e7f601.desc: PreToolUse deny reason when the hook belongs to a registration the attached machine has since replaced.

0996c28b7a18319be8d6d6ba938aae610e0f6ddd.name: Tool Result: Device Hook Decide Too Late
0996c28b7a18319be8d6d6ba938aae610e0f6ddd.desc: PreToolUse deny reason when the attached machine could not finish deciding before the cloud session stopped waiting.

d1c32771e831dc1377d114aa3ff89547c66ec274.name: Tool Result: Device Hook Internal Error
d1c32771e831dc1377d114aa3ff89547c66ec274.desc: PreToolUse deny reason when deciding the forwarded hook threw an internal error.

9efc30b5f36b65459f76a9a17d5896bf9a49f461.name: Tool Result: Device Hook Event Too Large
9efc30b5f36b65459f76a9a17d5896bf9a49f461.desc: PreToolUse deny reason from lo() when the event was too large to judge on the attached machine.

71728885db31d5dd2a4dbf429fea39e4557be4e1.name: PreToolUse Hook Too Many In Hand Result
71728885db31d5dd2a4dbf429fea39e4557be4e1.desc: Model-facing PreToolUse deny reason when a device hook is refused because too many cloud-session hook requests are already in hand.

bd454067ba8f52c508d25ca1c97c9e4988ec5351.name: PreToolUse Hook Machine Internal Error
bd454067ba8f52c508d25ca1c97c9e4988ec5351.desc: Fail-closed PreToolUse deny reason sent when a forwarded hook on the attached machine throws; the cloud worker returns it to the model as the blocked tool result.

aa383fbe0f678412d6687470371aa8d5ef478cbe.name: Slash Command: /plugin validate — capabilities field no longer read
aa383fbe0f678412d6687470371aa8d5ef478cbe.desc: Validation error telling the user to delete plugin.json's capabilities field because hooks are discovered from source and listed under hooks.json.

7cea8d608db449f54c288444c828ff024020ab88.name: Slash Command: /plugin validate — duplicate hooks modules
7cea8d608db449f54c288444c828ff024020ab88.desc: Validation error when both the plugin and a nested hooks.json each name a hooks module, so the loader refuses both.

7aba6310ce70d18b30233f6f5bb687d3cccc244b.name: Slash Command: /plugin tag — no version
7aba6310ce70d18b30233f6f5bb687d3cccc244b.desc: Error from /plugin tag when neither plugin.json nor the marketplace entry has a version, so a semver tag cannot be created.

7580074f8c15d22af59e5a48342ad7537d93e59d.name: Slash Command: /plugin tag — marketplace version location
7580074f8c15d22af59e5a48342ad7537d93e59d.desc: Suffix on the no-version tag error naming the marketplace plugins[i] slot as the other place a version can be set.

32a5b1b86850d038800fcefc4f1548dad8bacca1.name: Slash Command: /plugin tag — version mismatch
32a5b1b86850d038800fcefc4f1548dad8bacca1.desc: Error when plugin.json and the marketplace entry disagree on version; plugin.json wins at install, so the marketplace entry must be updated before tagging.

a15b8afc28d8aeb12a9bc8be7832ba33c34f2ba5.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Unknown — Omit Local
a15b8afc28d8aeb12a9bc8be7832ba33c34f2ba5.desc: unknown_host tool_result when the requested machine name is this session's own-environment sentinel, telling the model to omit it and run locally.

492985077d731b2bd48e8760a52741d5b5db6547.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Unknown — Respell
492985077d731b2bd48e8760a52741d5b5db6547.desc: unknown_host tool_result when an attached machine matches ignoring case or an (offline) suffix, telling the model the exact lower-case name to use.

de2f6be25891ecdedd77277a1824045cb432554a.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Unknown Offline Clause
de2f6be25891ecdedd77277a1824045cb432554a.desc: Clause appended to the respell unknown_host tool_result when the matched name is currently offline so a retry will fail until it reconnects.

f438f824f2002049f44b0885e533afa8a290574c.name: Tool Result: Remote Host None Attached — Not User's Machine
f438f824f2002049f44b0885e533afa8a290574c.desc: Fallback sentence in the unknown_host tool_result when no remote machine is attached, telling the model not to describe this session as the user's machine.

1f0d5ba7f836384fff6dfe5daff0a712422d3d0b.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Invisible-Chars Clause
1f0d5ba7f836384fff6dfe5daff0a712422d3d0b.desc: Parenthetical on the unknown_host tool_result when the requested name has extra or invisible characters relative to an attached host.

b550c6d30589518acbe769ecdf0f8d22c4d53515.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Unknown With Attached List
b550c6d30589518acbe769ecdf0f8d22c4d53515.desc: Fallback unknown_host tool_result naming the requested machine and listing attached hosts (or the no-machine sentence).

6614cef1b0f4b92626ca5824721cafe22f9640ba.name: Tool Result: Remote Host No Protocol Version Clause
6614cef1b0f4b92626ca5824721cafe22f9640ba.desc: Clause inside the protocol-incompatible tool_result when the machine announces no remote-tool protocol version this session reads.

310ff24dac7324de0e64d2143cc50beea0ef4780.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Session-Older Clause
310ff24dac7324de0e64d2143cc50beea0ef4780.desc: Clause inside the protocol-incompatible tool_result when this session's Claude Code is older than the machine and a newer cloud environment is required.

c4ea92a6f18c7919e84f0d66b585cb74e8a4eba5.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Tool Exists Only There Clause
c4ea92a6f18c7919e84f0d66b585cb74e8a4eba5.desc: Clause on the protocol-incompatible tool_result when runsOnlyThere is set, stating that tool exists only on the machine until versions match.

c3461c879cbbff228edd36906bfbb31766e36a5e.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Protocol Incompatible
c3461c879cbbff228edd36906bfbb31766e36a5e.desc: incompatible tool_result when the session and the attached machine share no remote-tool protocol version, so the call did not run.

582d18af005179fd1f327abba8bed8a54d66106c.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Bound Machine Not Connected
582d18af005179fd1f327abba8bed8a54d66106c.desc: host_offline tool_result when a machine is bound but its Claude Code has not connected, telling the model to ask the user to check that machine.

ef29bd308f2cff74df490f94ab173261129946ca.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Announced Tool Unreadable
ef29bd308f2cff74df490f94ab173261129946ca.desc: not_served tool_result when the host listed the tool in a form this session cannot read (rejected passthrough / version or naming mismatch).

5819f4f9c691e123e1e587c3273e789c47c2809c.name: Tool Result: Remote Host MCP Disconnected
5819f4f9c691e123e1e587c3273e789c47c2809c.desc: not_served tool_result when the attached machine does not currently serve the tool, often because its MCP server disconnected there.

a4cb040d0deea93b66b872156c1c0ca3fae1e659.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Not Served — Omit Local
a4cb040d0deea93b66b872156c1c0ca3fae1e659.desc: not_served tool_result when the named machine does not serve the tool, telling the model to omit the host qualifier and run it locally.

02d7fed71fc43357a30e5f75c4150dd84a90002a.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Plan Mode Blocked
02d7fed71fc43357a30e5f75c4150dd84a90002a.desc: plan_mode refuse tool_result blocking state-changing calls on a remote host until plan mode ends.

d6a1046c416afcbcfc7229f9ac73ef8174ed728c.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Request Too Large
d6a1046c416afcbcfc7229f9ac73ef8174ed728c.desc: request_too_large refuse/error tool_result when the call's input exceeds the per-host MiB cap and was not sent.

42258d484c4809151c84e139e19d85a7065b4abb.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Call Timed Out
42258d484c4809151c84e139e19d85a7065b4abb.desc: timed_out tool_result when the remote call exceeded the per-call limit; warns the command may still be running there.

6929dd6731980f760e59ba00b48d481879ec25cb.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Disconnected During Call
6929dd6731980f760e59ba00b48d481879ec25cb.desc: dropped tool_result when the host disconnected mid-call, telling the model not to re-run until it checks whether the command took effect.

298b1c902c283f6a090932ea947d78f72222b2b6.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Still Running
298b1c902c283f6a090932ea947d78f72222b2b6.desc: still_running tool_result when the host reports the command is still under way, telling the model not to re-run it.

1ca740917f1c03adf868541a1566934f4ddc3052.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Received Never Started
1ca740917f1c03adf868541a1566934f4ddc3052.desc: still_running tool_result when the host had admitted the call but nothing had started, so whether it then ran is unknown.

372442a114bc8c4503dfa99fc101988a5a5a4258.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Approval No Longer Accepted
372442a114bc8c4503dfa99fc101988a5a5a4258.desc: still_running tool_result when the host was awaiting a permission decision that it no longer accepts an answer to.

0df47c0436394edc24f4f8af35d67cbff84a5f16.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Approval Withdrawn
0df47c0436394edc24f4f8af35d67cbff84a5f16.desc: approval_not_received tool_result when the permission request was withdrawn on the host and nothing ran, so a retry is safe.

9a4318452cc03e619f99b37baf8b889bbf6853df.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Approval Withdrawn Race
9a4318452cc03e619f99b37baf8b889bbf6853df.desc: approval_not_received tool_result when the request was withdrawn but a delayed approval might have arrived first, so the model must check before retrying.

d4fcf801aaf8253f4dc39d2d2c11ee06027ae5dd.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Restarted Command Lost
d4fcf801aaf8253f4dc39d2d2c11ee06027ae5dd.desc: host_restarted tool_result when Claude Code on the machine restarted and the in-flight command was lost with it.

e65ca7d09e6b61b88f052946151de722aa90e143.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Never Received
e65ca7d09e6b61b88f052946151de722aa90e143.desc: not_received tool_result when the host reports it never got the call, so it did not run and a retry is safe.

60a521e5f23239c5c01261ac559df43dc460b341.name: Tool Result: Remote Host After-Reconnect Completed Suffix
60a521e5f23239c5c01261ac559df43dc460b341.desc: Suffix md() appends to a completed remote tool_result delivered after reconnect, stating this is the recorded result and the command was not run again.

bc4c26583758ffef083f03cc37db55a19e2bda52.name: Tool Result: Remote Host After-Reconnect Refused Suffix
bc4c26583758ffef083f03cc37db55a19e2bda52.desc: Suffix appended to a refused remote tool_result after reconnect, stating the first reply was lost and this is the refusal recorded then.

bd58bb2498d0d07838474ca724a12ddaa7f78246.name: Tool Result: Remote Host After-Reconnect Failed Suffix
bd58bb2498d0d07838474ca724a12ddaa7f78246.desc: Suffix appended to a failed remote tool_result after reconnect, stating the first reply was lost and this is how the call ended.

f8fa78acb4c59f19f9693997fedbfa16a73bf585.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Replayed Completed Suffix
f8fa78acb4c59f19f9693997fedbfa16a73bf585.desc: Suffix md() appends to a replayed completed remote tool_result, stating the call already ran at that UTC time and was not run again.

32d3005806f17e5bb4d47eac15118df70d061e1e.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Replayed Refused Suffix
32d3005806f17e5bb4d47eac15118df70d061e1e.desc: Suffix on a replayed refused remote tool_result, stating this is the refusal recorded at that time and nothing ran then or now.

900fdbae2b319d0f137fbe96a3579f2acf8599bb.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Replayed Failed Suffix
900fdbae2b319d0f137fbe96a3579f2acf8599bb.desc: Suffix on a replayed failed remote tool_result, stating this is how the call ended at that time and it was not run again.

c67ea097205ecf67f85fcf1e2aaf5249289e6520.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Failed In Transit
c67ea097205ecf67f85fcf1e2aaf5249289e6520.desc: transport_error tool_result when the call failed in transit with a readable detail, so it may not have run.

226e920ef5bfa33b83885a993e095c50bedb2b7e.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Unreadable Result Format
226e920ef5bfa33b83885a993e095c50bedb2b7e.desc: transport_error tool_result when the host answered in a result format this session cannot read, warning the command probably ran there.

62ad78458dd3b1b1da3296f4757fded22a1eed35.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Transport Error Unknown Run
62ad78458dd3b1b1da3296f4757fded22a1eed35.desc: transport_error tool_result when the connection answered with an error and the host did not report running the call, so whether it ran is unknown.

ed3f20ff4cc08539f84aa807588cad21169e484a.name: System Reminder: Tool Hosts Unknown-Sync Description
ed3f20ff4cc08539f84aa807588cad21169e484a.desc: Personal-machine description used when project sync is unknown, injected into the tool_hosts_notice attachment the model receives as ambient isMeta context.

235c2dcfec6317a0a65e74f9c655da6c4bb1c8cd.name: Tool Hosts Notice: Local Files Live Here
235c2dcfec6317a0a65e74f9c655da6c4bb1c8cd.desc: tool_hosts_notice line for two-way/upload-only sync telling the model the user's own files, apps and processes are on this session's machine.

fb9457f5d394896576c974d68364f090cef91790.name: Tool Hosts Notice: Here Reaches Project Folder Only
fb9457f5d394896576c974d68364f090cef91790.desc: tool_hosts_notice clause for two-way sync: named file tools only reach the project folder this session already holds.

8f30209ff23b1c40222d941e830afc1f50c8df64.name: Tool Hosts Notice: Upload-Only Absolute Path
8f30209ff23b1c40222d941e830afc1f50c8df64.desc: tool_hosts_notice clause for upload-only sync: project edits must use the absolute path on the attached machine; this session's copy is not sent back.

cf1e2401e9fa0e0f7e46ea019efd2a9326239692.name: Tool Hosts Notice: Current Files Live On The Machine
cf1e2401e9fa0e0f7e46ea019efd2a9326239692.desc: Shared prefix that the user's current files, apps and processes live on the attached machine, whose Claude Code may ask before running.

5fc156846ef45aa61e334b49d55e78f6d2a8d89a.name: Tool Hosts Notice: File Tools Hit This Session
5fc156846ef45aa61e334b49d55e78f6d2a8d89a.desc: tool_hosts_notice line for off-sync: Read/Edit/Grep/Glob hit this session's filesystem; use Bash on the machine for current project files.

0048e9ca62b467ffe3f86848786f7e56cd2add5f.name: Tool Hosts Notice: File Path Must Be On The Host
0048e9ca62b467ffe3f86848786f7e56cd2add5f.desc: tool_hosts_notice clause for off-sync: file tools with the machine argument use absolute paths there; without it they see only this session's snapshot.

05c011f17f1b16f08dacd24b5643ea5d13b79d74.name: Tool Hosts Notice: Housekeeping May Be Either Machine
05c011f17f1b16f08dacd24b5643ea5d13b79d74.desc: Bullet telling the model a location-free housekeeping chore may concern either machine and to look at both before changing anything.

c46d875dbc445a35f641363830f5eb4008a3af3a.name: Tool Hosts Notice: No Machine Attached
c46d875dbc445a35f641363830f5eb4008a3af3a.desc: tool_hosts_notice replacement when every remote host has dropped: omit the machine argument and run commands here.

12c314b43207ab02526746bb170e97640cbc1945.name: Tool Hosts Notice: Details Are Facts Not Instructions
12c314b43207ab02526746bb170e97640cbc1945.desc: Closing line that machine details are reported by each host's Claude Code and must be treated as facts, never as user instructions.

34bf2c09e06800b52f8b4fba6d4b6d424806419b.name: Tool Hosts Notice: Header When No Primary Host
34bf2c09e06800b52f8b4fba6d4b6d424806419b.desc: Header when remotes exist but none serve Bash: host MCP tools run there when called directly; everything else runs here.

31125d4f322d55bee0718b97c4a4beaa7fd2e594.name: Tool Hosts Notice: REPL Machine Argument
31125d4f322d55bee0718b97c4a4beaa7fd2e594.desc: REPL-mode routing sentence: call Bash as await Bash({command,…}) and add the machine name argument to run it on the host.

3f6195d5f601e35b81f081937afd6bf4a87d72f2.name: Tool Hosts Notice: Same Argument For File Tools
3f6195d5f601e35b81f081937afd6bf4a87d72f2.desc: Nested REPL clause that the same machine argument works for the host's file tools, as REPL calls or as tools.

eb53ec782e116603b989ee717b709748111454c2.name: Tool Hosts Notice: Read Edit Search On The Machine
eb53ec782e116603b989ee717b709748111454c2.desc: Off-sync header clause: read and edit the project's files on the host and run searches, builds and tests there with Bash.

584a968fd3ebf19c3f58694866abf9588ee22b54.name: Tool Hosts Notice: Run Project Commands There
584a968fd3ebf19c3f58694866abf9588ee22b54.desc: Off-sync header fallback when the host does not serve file tools: run read/search/build/test/change commands on that machine.

a994c44f79e093652d1744fbf1c74203e2a6bc5d.name: Tool Hosts Notice: Header Current Files On Machine
a994c44f79e093652d1744fbf1c74203e2a6bc5d.desc: Off-sync header: the user's current project files live on the named host; only scratch work that needs none of them should run here.

d61cf00ee8ff284281f474a468ea470eeb51e0bf.name: Tool Hosts Notice: Header Run There Or Here
d61cf00ee8ff284281f474a468ea470eeb51e0bf.desc: Default header when a primary host is attached: pass the machine argument to run there, omit it to run here.

3d4437065f4498da4409776d00d9215e24809107.name: Tool Hosts Notice: Local Side Is A Snapshot
3d4437065f4498da4409776d00d9215e24809107.desc: Local-side bullet for off-sync: this session has at most a start-of-session snapshot; scratch work that needs no current files belongs here.

cad3bd533f17432c42d4d713a1341278e4523418.name: Tool Hosts Notice: Host Offline
cad3bd533f17432c42d4d713a1341278e4523418.desc: Per-host bullet when the remote is offline: calls naming it will fail until it reconnects.

c6b9aef869f8ab63110436a409a22819c621958a.name: Tool Hosts Notice: Incompatible MCP Will Not Run
c6b9aef869f8ab63110436a409a22819c621958a.desc: Suffix on the incompatible-protocol bullet when the host also advertised passthrough MCP tools that will not run from here.

bb03c292967bc8fceeb4a052576b4ce2c23ea3af.name: Tool Hosts Notice: Incompatible Remote-Tool Protocol
bb03c292967bc8fceeb4a052576b4ce2c23ea3af.desc: Per-host bullet when this session and the host share no remote-tool protocol version, so calls to it will fail until the older side is updated.

1f40f40f4c4f50c1f6d84587a352a43dab269f53.name: Tool Hosts Notice: Passthrough MCP Tools
1f40f40f4c4f50c1f6d84587a352a43dab269f53.desc: Per-host note that the host's own MCP tools run there with that machine's logins; a server this session also runs appears a second time locally.

c0d2bc80e0c9c4e25ff63d6323c56e80ac773242.name: Tool Hosts Notice: Rejected Passthrough MCP
c0d2bc80e0c9c4e25ff63d6323c56e80ac773242.desc: Per-host note that some of the host's MCP tools were announced in a form this session cannot read and will not run from here.

fd04d28d4c3ddb6a54d01c8a1a0877f0b417ccef.name: Tool Hosts Notice: Project Upload-Only Sync
fd04d28d4c3ddb6a54d01c8a1a0877f0b417ccef.desc: Host description fragment: the project path is upload-only — saved changes there arrive before each user message; changes here are not sent back.

5e576db7c7f19ef3a397a0463cb1bbd848dfc9dc.name: Tool Hosts Notice: Project Not Synced
5e576db7c7f19ef3a397a0463cb1bbd848dfc9dc.desc: Host description fragment: the project path on the machine is not synced with this session.

c93590b08b9420500b25853aab3719f902803caf.name: Remote Tool: Ask Rule Keyed On Machine Argument
c93590b08b9420500b25853aab3719f902803caf.desc: Session-rule refusal when an ask rule matches the machine argument itself, which this session cannot honour as a prompt.

74e4b1a72f27b1bf87ed558be9cd47924d79050c.name: Remote Tool: Bridge Denied By Session Rule
74e4b1a72f27b1bf87ed558be9cd47924d79050c.desc: Refusal when a deny rule on the bridge name blocks forwarding, so the tool is not sent to the host either.

d6d8defb38b62506aebf6d9a4c18af6dee59adc2.name: Remote Tool: MCP Rule This Session Cannot Check
d6d8defb38b62506aebf6d9a4c18af6dee59adc2.desc: Refusal when a forwarded MCP call has a field-level rule this session cannot evaluate, so every forwarded call is refused.

ca4686b0a6dcc7cd4e39e4d0c7eca47f83f67664.name: Remote Tool: Bridge Rule This Session Cannot Check
ca4686b0a6dcc7cd4e39e4d0c7eca47f83f67664.desc: Refusal when a bridge-name rule cannot be checked field-by-field (command pattern or machine field), so every forwarded call of that tool is refused.

1f75e4933b95f698a601bbc7864c303b1c017d5b.name: Remote Tool: Permission Eval Internal Error
1f75e4933b95f698a601bbc7864c303b1c017d5b.desc: Refusal when this session could not evaluate its permission rules for the forwarded call (internal error).

e4ee7bd2c8d0c73893ddbe984e766f00582b5f39.name: Remote Tool: Bridge Ask Cannot Prompt
e4ee7bd2c8d0c73893ddbe984e766f00582b5f39.desc: Refusal when a session ask-rule on the bridge fires but this context cannot show a permission prompt (dontAsk / no prompts).

e27e3d989f94b89befa7deb2f470bb7976c04cb6.name: Remote Tool: Session Asks Before Host Tools
e27e3d989f94b89befa7deb2f470bb7976c04cb6.desc: ask_first permission message when a session rule asks before using the host's tools; on decline it is the tool_result the model reads.

a70afc1b6fd0d342151c7d5cd439dee8afa24b0a.name: Remote Tool: Ask-First With No Prompt Surface
a70afc1b6fd0d342151c7d5cd439dee8afa24b0a.desc: Error tool_result when ask_first fires but this session has no approve callback, so the host is not contacted.

1eb4b04a821e096a82574a58f409f7b947c14867.name: Remote Tool: Permission Prompt Failed
1eb4b04a821e096a82574a58f409f7b947c14867.desc: Error tool_result when this session's own permission prompt threw, so the forwarded call did not run.

deceaf2d4cc9aa52826db502ed0722b4b8424459.name: Remote Tool: Edited Input Invalid, Host Not Contacted
deceaf2d4cc9aa52826db502ed0722b4b8424459.desc: Error tool_result when the permission prompt's updatedInput fails the tool schema, so the host is not contacted.

2453bc3ba8801cbb073b411fdb2ce9616f23dbf1.name: Remote Tool: Unreadable Host Ask
2453bc3ba8801cbb073b411fdb2ce9616f23dbf1.desc: Error tool_result when the host asked for approval of a call this session could not parse, so nothing ran.

699cf014d59dfea3d736e15256f7e9fb7b8c417e.name: Remote Tool: Unanswerable Prompt, Call Did Not Run
699cf014d59dfea3d736e15256f7e9fb7b8c417e.desc: Error tool_result when the session permission prompt is unanswerable, appending that the call did not run on the host.

9d576da0ee1e5124676b1789d3e93b2fb2812666.name: Remote Tool: Edited Input Invalid, Not Sent
9d576da0ee1e5124676b1789d3e93b2fb2812666.desc: Late-path refusal when updatedInput from the host's own ask fails to parse, so the edited call is not sent.

5f6d4682db27cbf5eb45ab437be494807feac2e7.name: Remote Tool: Late Ask After Approval
5f6d4682db27cbf5eb45ab437be494807feac2e7.desc: Late refusal when a session ask-rule appears after the call was already approved, so the host is not contacted.

65c75d03b7fa416d690c7ba822687ed8407a638a.name: Remote Tool: Suspended Call Withdrawn
65c75d03b7fa416d690c7ba822687ed8407a638a.desc: Error tool_result when a late refusal hits a host that had already been asked: the suspended call is withdrawn and nothing ran there.

347b6871937a54224173a4e68a45ad36facbb0c9.name: Remote Tool Result: Cut To Session Limits
347b6871937a54224173a4e68a45ad36facbb0c9.desc: Suffix appended onto a forwarded tool_result when this session cut the host's result to its own text/image/block limits.

9f9f8e28493077e720d0a5cd8f513fca0f35182c.name: Remote Tool Result: Truncated To First N Characters
9f9f8e28493077e720d0a5cd8f513fca0f35182c.desc: Suffix appended onto a forwarded tool_result when this session kept only the first N characters of the host's answer.

51dd51d30b5f577fee1e7b06635e61d20356068d.name: Remote Tool Result: Answered Without Run Details
51dd51d30b5f577fee1e7b06635e61d20356068d.desc: Lead line prepended to a forwarded tool_result when the host answered without a present envelope, so whether the command ran is unverified.

f9a6ec2004dcfd2e447963c9f51c774bd00c9144.name: Remote Tool Result: Blocked Before Run
f9a6ec2004dcfd2e447963c9f51c774bd00c9144.desc: Lead line on a forwarded tool_result when the host blocked the call with a hook or deny rule before it ran.

38004dfb5898b18639db18e71ed23dc851ec175d.name: Remote Tool Result: Unrecognized Outcome
38004dfb5898b18639db18e71ed23dc851ec175d.desc: Lead line when the host returned an outcome this Claude Code version does not recognise, so whether the command ran is unknown.

d83ee06f680b6a6b921fc210710cc054d1c7d852.name: Remote Tool Result: Saved Output File On Host
d83ee06f680b6a6b921fc210710cc054d1c7d852.desc: hostLocal suffix telling the model the saved output file lives on the remote machine and must be read there.

1571be1b560373a2db03e44251828ddd4ff981d4.name: Remote Tool Result: Background Task On Host
1571be1b560373a2db03e44251828ddd4ff981d4.desc: hostLocal suffix that the command keeps running as a background task on the remote machine and this session is not notified when it finishes.

38ca90711e14c359883c755f981e40f141177aa7.name: Remote Tool: Host Ask With No Prompt Surface
38ca90711e14c359883c755f981e40f141177aa7.desc: insteadOfRejection tool_result when the host asked for approval and this context cannot show a permission prompt, so the call did not run.

63bd52f841884751b244700663d91a2a02f045b2.name: Remote Tool: Approval Edit Cannot Apply On Host
63bd52f841884751b244700663d91a2a02f045b2.desc: insteadOfRejection tool_result when the session approval edited the call in a way the host cannot honour (different machine or a privileged field).

d8d243c9dfea1169f8cc1081cf1d5aa1487ec6e9.name: Remote Tool: Host Ask Unanswerable, No Audience
d8d243c9dfea1169f8cc1081cf1d5aa1487ec6e9.desc: insteadOfRejection tool_result when the host asked and this session had no way to put the question to anyone; tells the model to ask the user rather than retry.

c14cfd1b2d6e65246e378ac33f6a99353d649d8f.name: Permission Classifier: Remote Host Command Prefix
c14cfd1b2d6e65246e378ac33f6a99353d649d8f.desc: Prefix wrapped around a Bash command before the auto-mode permission classifier runs, stating it would run on another machine and quoting that machine's unverified ask reason.

32621c0490998ab9a4a529e9010a4e92fb4370b8.name: Tool Description: Get Device Info (Idle Attached Note)
32621c0490998ab9a4a529e9010a4e92fb4370b8.desc: Suffix appended to the get_device_info tool description when this machine is attached but does not run device commands for the current session.

3557fd604ff8a9191e2031325e2a4dbb4a6049dd.name: Tool Result: Cloud Template Stand-In Blocked
3557fd604ff8a9191e2031325e2a4dbb4a6049dd.desc: PreToolUse deny message when a cloud hook template could not be installed on this worker, blocking matching calls until it is registered again.

f4f0644862bd3d727fefe56b17feb160cdcc6d0c.name: Slash Command: /cd — only listed directory patterns allowed
f4f0644862bd3d727fefe56b17feb160cdcc6d0c.desc: Tells the model the exact allow-list of directory patterns /cd is restricted to, which is the information it needs to pick a legal target on the next attempt.

2cccd93d93c890d77a00e04b7b8d1f96d0c0d881.name: Tool Result: set_cwd Blocked By Allowed Patterns
2cccd93d93c890d77a00e04b7b8d1f96d0c0d881.desc: set_cwd rejection telling the model directory changes are limited to the listed allowedPatterns and to pick a matching directory.

1f8916ad3ea3bd8c1355298de43c55ad6023a023.name: Working-Directory-Changed Notice (Relative Paths And Project Context)
1f8916ad3ea3bd8c1355298de43c55ad6023a023.desc: Continuation of the cwd-changed modelMessage: relative paths, project settings/MCP/skills, and CLAUDE.md now come from the new directory.

e68df5635c6ec04789dcd11d886a17849278d296.name: Working-Directory-Changed Notice (Settings Env Overlay)
e68df5635c6ec04789dcd11d886a17849278d296.desc: Continuation of the cwd-changed modelMessage stating the new directory's settings env is applied on top of the previous directory's still-effective process env.

6320c93ea39302e1579074a6153249b90e5d3ccf.name: Working-Directory-Changed Notice (Gated Project Grants)
6320c93ea39302e1579074a6153249b90e5d3ccf.desc: modelMessage note that the new directory's project permission rules and additional directories are not applied because the workspace is only trusted via a parent grant.

5542014b0c305facea4560d2b9abe66908f2353f.name: Working-Directory-Changed Notice (Explicit Trust Applied)
5542014b0c305facea4560d2b9abe66908f2353f.desc: Replacement modelMessage fragment after the user explicitly trusts the new directory, stating its project permission rules and additional directories are now applied.

9bf452537a4bcd6334c776780117343a406382b3.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync Head Fast-Forwarded
9bf452537a4bcd6334c776780117343a406382b3.desc: Cloud dir-sync notice that the user's machine fast-forwarded the work branch with new commits.

ad0dc4318210ff3c8f23272ed13cffa6e9c1ca18.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync Head Moved
ad0dc4318210ff3c8f23272ed13cffa6e9c1ca18.desc: Cloud dir-sync notice that the user moved their checkout (branch switch/rebase/amend/reset) so the work branch now points at a history that does not contain the previous HEAD.

6fddbc5b87a3c9999c02d9e408c4bb552b671ece.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync Head Restored
6fddbc5b87a3c9999c02d9e408c4bb552b671ece.desc: Cloud dir-sync notice that the work branch is back on the user's previous HEAD.

ccd53dedfc806c79ecb8f74da0e08cfa7e5a93d0.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync Rewrite Reparented Guidance
ccd53dedfc806c79ecb8f74da0e08cfa7e5a93d0.desc: Tells the cloud agent that rewritten commits were re-created or left as uncommitted changes and to make a NEW commit rather than reset/amend/rebase user history.

9ccc5bb36feb03d21bd18c3013a0e29c47fa0f90.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync Rewrite Uncommitted Guidance
9ccc5bb36feb03d21bd18c3013a0e29c47fa0f90.desc: Tells the cloud agent the working tree still holds its rewrite as uncommitted changes that will sync back, and to commit as NEW or restore.

1f581c559c181fcd2562886f62df97d3dab31513.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync Restored User Commits
1f581c559c181fcd2562886f62df97d3dab31513.desc: Tells the cloud agent it had removed or rewritten commits the user already has, so those commits were put back and must not be reset/amended/rebased.

476e24015edb5e918c807434f3b2d50e183baae7.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync User Branch Followed
476e24015edb5e918c807434f3b2d50e183baae7.desc: Tells the cloud agent the checkout followed the user's branch (or detached HEAD), including any previous tip kept under a ref.

25d1f88421f13f3ee2a9e59e850063dd7f2a0fd6.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync User Branch Previous Tip Kept
25d1f88421f13f3ee2a9e59e850063dd7f2a0fd6.desc: Inner clause of the user-branch-followed notice: this checkout's same-named branch tip is kept at a ref because the user's branch does not contain it.

161f5dacad454d2ac8275c03395d879357815e9b.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync Agent Commits Reparented
161f5dacad454d2ac8275c03395d879357815e9b.desc: Tells the cloud agent its unpublished commits were re-created on top of the user's HEAD, with old→new ids and any empty drops.

f3f9e6b4b713deb926a83e753773741f5e8a880b.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync Parked Reason Already On Remote
f3f9e6b4b713deb926a83e753773741f5e8a880b.desc: Reason phrase interpolated into the parked-commits notice when some agent commits are already on the remote, so merge or pull before push.

521c19bb7762eb143f0c6a3224aa4f733b188cc1.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync Parked Reason Cannot Recreate
521c19bb7762eb143f0c6a3224aa4f733b188cc1.desc: Reason phrase interpolated into the parked-commits notice when commits could not be re-created (root commit, non-UTF-8, or signing/identity).

2c988370975558d84824a8f9ee97f36ca8903a70.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync Merge Unsettled
2c988370975558d84824a8f9ee97f36ca8903a70.desc: Tells the cloud agent git could not settle some paths cleanly (rename/file-dir/submodule) so they must be checked before use.

2b8360c1ccbf30c97f23ab1f53e6435b5bb71eb8.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync Edit Over Delete
2b8360c1ccbf30c97f23ab1f53e6435b5bb71eb8.desc: Tells the cloud agent a delete met an edit and the edited version was kept.

e1df06978376dea7f7a5af3be9eb94eed43d1ad5.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync Files Trashed
e1df06978376dea7f7a5af3be9eb94eed43d1ad5.desc: Tells the cloud agent paths removed on the user's machine were moved out of this checkout.

8946e3cbef1ec2474a30e516cfa2a941a94eebf7.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync Files Displaced
8946e3cbef1ec2474a30e516cfa2a941a94eebf7.desc: Tells the cloud agent local-only files that blocked incoming paths were moved to session trash rather than overwritten.

f7b2ceeb39672dff3e0af12ed3a211523b54eead.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync Files Not Taken
f7b2ceeb39672dff3e0af12ed3a211523b54eead.desc: Tells the cloud agent some user-side changes were left as-is here, with the skip reasons and paths.

48782ebfa26e496bc2b862680c49913deccfce61.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync Credential-Named Uncommitted Skipped
48782ebfa26e496bc2b862680c49913deccfce61.desc: Tells the cloud agent uncommitted user changes to credential-named files are not brought into this checkout.

eb4e50f704988fd6e8327f1521a0227579e8bcd4.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync Index Not Mirrored
eb4e50f704988fd6e8327f1521a0227579e8bcd4.desc: Tells the cloud agent the index could not be updated to the user's staging and how to re-sync it with git reset.

61f4ddc5791afc63736ccffe308bceee6eb9a29a.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync Agent Staging Dropped
61f4ddc5791afc63736ccffe308bceee6eb9a29a.desc: Tells the cloud agent the index now mirrors the user's staging, so what it had staged is unstaged (contents unchanged).

8c9f88903868f8747b80e054b2aa20395f8feee5.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync Not Installed On User Machine
8c9f88903868f8747b80e054b2aa20395f8feee5.desc: Tells the cloud agent files it changed earlier were not written on the user's machine, so the user's copy stands there.

4c9808b9e6e3d5ece780b46c43f2518a9ea8c208.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync Checkout Updated From User
4c9808b9e6e3d5ece780b46c43f2518a9ea8c208.desc: Lead line of the cloud dir-sync turn-start notice that this checkout was updated from the user's machine.

6eff549217aa269dad824fc59f6ffa75c4a3bb86.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync Not-Installed Reason Outside Checkout
6eff549217aa269dad824fc59f6ffa75c4a3bb86.desc: Reason phrase Ya() interpolates into the not-installed-on-user-machine notice when the path would leave the checkout via a link.

5c111467f869ca2957fb67a3e098ef84a7b44ab3.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync Turn Changes Too Large To Send
5c111467f869ca2957fb67a3e098ef84a7b44ab3.desc: Cloud dir-sync notice that this turn's changes exceeded the size cap and remain here until a later turn's delta fits.

ae61968d96d2e4e4dc46e0c0084778894f279809.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync Held-Back Work Now Sent
ae61968d96d2e4e4dc46e0c0084778894f279809.desc: Cloud dir-sync notice that this turn's result fit and previously size-capped work has now reached the user's machine.

c588eea173b87e37e72d147a045f305a2fb07973.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync Duplicate Generation Ignored
c588eea173b87e37e72d147a045f305a2fb07973.desc: Tells the cloud agent the user's machine sent two different snapshots under the same generation, so the second was ignored and mentioned files may be missing.

e421b08537fbc29caf2493d2262f72986ba322f9.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync Not-Applied Reason Mid-Operation
e421b08537fbc29caf2493d2262f72986ba322f9.desc: Reason phrase interpolated into the cloud not-applied notice when this checkout is in the middle of a merge, rebase, or cherry-pick.

b63b492e3692870160c6352aff1cb06999c0df38.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync Not-Applied Reason Worktree Changed
b63b492e3692870160c6352aff1cb06999c0df38.desc: Reason phrase interpolated into the cloud not-applied notice when a file changed while the snapshot was being prepared.

e48814bfc46bed53dc87a32f204d1333a2858971.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync Not-Applied Reason Git Error
e48814bfc46bed53dc87a32f204d1333a2858971.desc: Reason phrase interpolated into the cloud not-applied notice when git reported an error, optionally quoting git's output as data.

646d0dc5a1e5d41b86baaafeb4789aa2693e2067.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync Not-Applied Reason Git Error Quoted Output
646d0dc5a1e5d41b86baaafeb4789aa2693e2067.desc: Optional suffix of the git-error reason that quotes git's output as data, not an instruction.

703a611c12e2426a0bf82cf9e1ea479ccca1233d.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync User Changes Refused
703a611c12e2426a0bf82cf9e1ea479ccca1233d.desc: Tells the cloud agent the user's latest changes were refused and are not in this checkout until a fresh snapshot arrives.

fa118df243b31dcc11749ff9bef7404384522e3c.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync User Changes Gave Up Waiting
fa118df243b31dcc11749ff9bef7404384522e3c.desc: Tells the cloud agent the user's latest changes did not arrive after several turns, so the machine was asked to resend and the checkout still lacks them.

c6018c748f913f3241bab78ad72d6e78c13224da.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync User Changes Still Downloading
c6018c748f913f3241bab78ad72d6e78c13224da.desc: Tells the cloud agent the user's latest changes are still downloading and are not in the checkout yet, and to say so if the request depends on them.

ef8510d25d7e5d90b06c9a824c645cec7ad8f4b2.name: Data: Directory sync overcap file listing
ef8510d25d7e5d90b06c9a824c645cec7ad8f4b2.desc: Per-file size/commit listing interpolated into the overcap dir_sync_notice reminder so the model can name the blobs blocking sync.

f5aaaf095686bffef44211dddbb42e3536963de5.name: System Reminder: Directory sync turn overcap
f5aaaf095686bffef44211dddbb42e3536963de5.desc: dir_sync_notice telling the model this turn's work exceeded the sync size cap, nothing reaches the user until the named blobs are removed, and how to drop committed vs uncommitted files.

f9cb09f6ac91ec69308551e6451eeb19404ba5f6.name: System Reminder: Directory sync oversize files not sent
f9cb09f6ac91ec69308551e6451eeb19404ba5f6.desc: dir_sync_notice listing per-file oversize paths that were not synced to the user's machine and instructing the model to tell the user and keep large artefacts out of the tree.

ba3fdedac51ff688114a111f5dd66b6c9dbc8577.name: Data: Directory sync nested repo keep as ordinary files
ba3fdedac51ff688114a111f5dd66b6c9dbc8577.desc: Advice tail interpolated into the nested-repository dir_sync_notice when every nested repo can sync if rewritten as ordinary files.

982ac9b12fd6a4d33ba995b95a7c62d0382e9682.name: Data: Directory sync nested repo inside uncarried directory
982ac9b12fd6a4d33ba995b95a7c62d0382e9682.desc: Advice tail interpolated into the nested-repository dir_sync_notice when the nested repos also sit under a path sync does not carry.

8410debbe8fb84f8cae350a83547edc27d92c36b.name: Data: Directory sync nested repo ordinary except uncarried
8410debbe8fb84f8cae350a83547edc27d92c36b.desc: Advice tail interpolated into the nested-repository dir_sync_notice when some nested repos would sync as ordinary files except those under an uncarried directory.

0c758d47a87d073ee729f359bf62c9154db2de95.name: System Reminder: Directory sync nested repository not entered
0c758d47a87d073ee729f359bf62c9154db2de95.desc: dir_sync_notice telling the model sync never enters a nested git repo so nothing inside it reaches the user's machine, and to tell the user if those files are needed.

cd633847624603b165fdee4180bae71c93fe06d7.name: Data: Directory sync apply interrupted, checkout maybe partial
cd633847624603b165fdee4180bae71c93fe06d7.desc: Residue phrase joined into the unfinished-checkout dir_sync_notice when apply throws, telling the model the checkout may be partly updated.

4cef1b99f20936f108c96e8fb6ce98ba80ea8e77.name: Data: Directory sync apply partial rewrite not undone
4cef1b99f20936f108c96e8fb6ce98ba80ea8e77.desc: Residue phrase joined into the unfinished-checkout dir_sync_notice when read-tree fails midway and cannot be reset.

344a7bc7fa72ee86ed97973a0a0441c9807e5107.name: Data: Directory sync deleted files moved to session trash
344a7bc7fa72ee86ed97973a0a0441c9807e5107.desc: Residue fragment joined into the unfinished-checkout dir_sync_notice when HEAD cannot be moved after deletes were already trashed.

37edc82bfe61d9c77abf2ab8671a46e7318a6919.name: Data: Directory sync shadowed files moved to session trash
37edc82bfe61d9c77abf2ab8671a46e7318a6919.desc: Residue fragment joined into the unfinished-checkout dir_sync_notice when checkout-owned files that stood in incoming paths were trashed and HEAD then failed to move.

fe8396579812a08dfcd5f6553478a71f4a648319.name: Data: Directory sync HEAD move unconfirmed
fe8396579812a08dfcd5f6553478a71f4a648319.desc: Residue sentence joined into the unfinished-checkout dir_sync_notice when git declined or could not confirm the planned HEAD move.

3721a15577cfbff9af390b82e3583f0137d90cb5.desc: validateInput refusal when file_path is neither .html/.htm nor markdown.

c26e6db43f07b631644f4df35eb1b887e12191b9.name: Artifact Preview Empty File
c26e6db43f07b631644f4df35eb1b887e12191b9.desc: Sne validateInput empty-file message telling the model to write the page before previewing.

d938b00facf117e4eeb13d29352effc1d374e794.name: Artifact Preview No File Identity Validate
d938b00facf117e4eeb13d29352effc1d374e794.desc: Sne validateInput noIdentity string (no trailing period; Sne appends one) when the file cannot be identified.

865931fcb52e1c7ce32a255e86df9a46e1785b6c.name: Artifact Preview Auto-Classifier Input
865931fcb52e1c7ce32a255e86df9a46e1785b6c.desc: toAutoClassifierInput line describing a local preview render for the auto-permission classifier model.

9340f4e024f49c06d94553d2be01bec805fbc9a9.name: Artifact Preview Action Description
9340f4e024f49c06d94553d2be01bec805fbc9a9.desc: Per-call description for Artifact action preview: render a local page in a headless browser without uploading.

72ed44faa61c890b941e29453acd4d108e17dfdb.name: Artifact Stale Guard Persisted Autoread Body
72ed44faa61c890b941e29453acd4d108e17dfdb.desc: Persisted-mode stale-version guard body: the live source is saved at a path, counts as viewed, and must be Read and merged before republishing.

bfa8ff3f0da3597beea68fd6a931fb6b17b2a0eb.name: Artifact Stale Guard Persisted Read-In-Full Clause
bfa8ff3f0da3597beea68fd6a931fb6b17b2a0eb.desc: Seed-on-read branch of the persisted stale-guard body telling the model that version counts as viewed only once every line has been Read.

dec627f86c5167d81d57c4a8d0bf65b5cd2cd716.name: Artifact Identical Resubmission Unviewed
dec627f86c5167d81d57c4a8d0bf65b5cd2cd716.desc: identical_resubmission_unviewed publish tool_result stem when the newer live version still does not count as viewed.

c77375dd4e190cc24ea76fc2ae5ff2aeb26fb684.name: Artifact Identical Resubmission Fetch To Confirm
c77375dd4e190cc24ea76fc2ae5ff2aeb26fb684.desc: Clause telling the model a Read of the saved copy does not confirm the live version and to fetch the artifact URL again.

89b60d4621604b6da12b7cd02ad371fce8d5fdcf.name: Artifact Identical Resubmission Resent Unchanged
89b60d4621604b6da12b7cd02ad371fce8d5fdcf.desc: identical_resubmission publish tool_result stem when the same refused content is resent unchanged.

23497456eb654b929cf07d9b423f86945f9f5ed3.name: Artifact Identical Resubmission Sourceless
23497456eb654b929cf07d9b423f86945f9f5ed3.desc: identical_resubmission clause covering both unseen live versions and versions that arrived only as summary or page data.

2c848eee953e1f2985db7b376f126b13be7db24a.name: Artifact Identical Resubmission Sourceless Clause
2c848eee953e1f2985db7b376f126b13be7db24a.desc: identical_resubmission publish error clause when the live version reached the model only as a summary or page data, never as source.

59a656bdf2bbf741decb12637ba434558571e9df.name: Artifact Delete — Consent Ask
59a656bdf2bbf741decb12637ba434558571e9df.desc: The permanent-delete confirmation prompt, used both as the ask message and as its safetyCheck decisionReason.

f6134d702d1265cddb12c96c4c16be74a1062090.name: Artifact Delete Action Description
f6134d702d1265cddb12c96c4c16be74a1062090.desc: Per-call description for action delete: permanently deletes an artifact the user owns; every delete asks the user.

6794661fcd08c5adfaebdbed6acf641747009526.name: Artifact Auto-Open After First Write
6794661fcd08c5adfaebdbed6acf641747009526.desc: validateInput refusal when auto_open is after_first_write on a type_url create, which is already the first write.

b2795dc734717510bbeaefe23a2a99937660821d.name: Tool Description: Bash Sandbox Intro
b2795dc734717510bbeaefe23a2a99937660821d.desc: Opening paragraph of the command-sandbox section of the Bash tool description stating commands run in a sandbox that controls filesystem and network access.

17007d7abed1c103a99be18c22c9dfba9f2d4eca.name: Tool Result: Worktree Create Filter Name Unrepresentable
17007d7abed1c103a99be18c22c9dfba9f2d4eca.desc: WorktreeIsolationError when a git filter driver name cannot be neutralized; returned to the model as an EnterWorktree tool error.

84b962693273a763c91ce66b918db64c3513be44.name: Tool Result: Worktree Create Conditional Include
84b962693273a763c91ce66b918db64c3513be44.desc: WorktreeIsolationError when includeIf makes checkout filter drivers unknowable; returned to the model as an EnterWorktree tool error.

17114e2078ffcf1ad57de67fd31126754966e375.name: System Reminder: Memory File Over Recall Limit
17114e2078ffcf1ad57de67fd31126754966e375.desc: PostToolUse additionalContext after a memory-file write that exceeded the recall cap, telling the model to rewrite it under the limit.

22db0f0a984fb200e21ff13ca7168130b7ddb9e5.name: System Reminder: Memory File Approaching Recall Limit
22db0f0a984fb200e21ff13ca7168130b7ddb9e5.desc: PostToolUse additionalContext when a memory file is approaching the recall cap.

07b22c0e17a3387b8f1e2e2fe11f2e36c5d7ac5b.name: System Reminder: Memory File Missing Description
07b22c0e17a3387b8f1e2e2fe11f2e36c5d7ac5b.desc: PostToolUse additionalContext lint telling the model a memory file lacks frontmatter description.

3ac7b9cf5bba2ee3b5909af24dd8d6cd0ca5fe0b.name: System Reminder: Memory File Long Description
3ac7b9cf5bba2ee3b5909af24dd8d6cd0ca5fe0b.desc: PostToolUse additionalContext lint telling the model to shorten a memory file's description.

fc0477a0ef24810dd82cb89ca91e2c971d63ff63.name: System Reminder: Command Sandbox Disabled
fc0477a0ef24810dd82cb89ca91e2c971d63ff63.desc: Meta reminder injected when sandbox_instructions content is empty, telling the model commands now run unsandboxed.

42abca2a8546eaf11013c51ab9d10da83fad02cb.name: System Reminder: Cowork Memory Snapshot Withdrawn
42abca2a8546eaf11013c51ab9d10da83fad02cb.desc: Meta reminder when cowork_memory_context content is null, telling the model to disregard the previous memory snapshot.

51e748c6b5001899f22d814df6896de39d8ab6f6.name: Slash Command: /terminal-setup — This Terminal Supports Shift+Enter Natively
51e748c6b5001899f22d814df6896de39d8ab6f6.desc: Tells the model the named terminal (Ghostty/Kitty/Warp/WezTerm/Windows Terminal) needs no setup, so a follow-up install attempt would be pointless.

e12063496aee4b39a50128afe01e87f8c3ba875a.name: Slash Command: /terminal-setup — Zed Keymap Manual Block
e12063496aee4b39a50128afe01e87f8c3ba875a.desc: /terminal-setup dim helper showing the Zed keymap.json Shift+Enter binding to add by hand when the installer cannot write it.

2ac44f001d1e3059570ba679b2c5df0712aae058.name: Slash Command: /terminal-setup — Zed Keymap Unreadable
2ac44f001d1e3059570ba679b2c5df0712aae058.desc: Assembled /terminal-setup warning when Zed keymap.json cannot be read, including the manual binding block.

1f80b601ece681df104d0a186efec9a9423c85c2.name: Slash Command: /terminal-setup — Zed Keymap Unreadable Text
1f80b601ece681df104d0a186efec9a9423c85c2.desc: Warning sentence when /terminal-setup cannot read Zed keymap.json, so the file is left unchanged.

a312fc9a88cae1753ea1c00d158008ae4cad4e7b.name: Slash Command: /terminal-setup — Zed Keymap Not A List
a312fc9a88cae1753ea1c00d158008ae4cad4e7b.desc: Assembled /terminal-setup warning when keymap.json parses but is not an array of bindings.

1e92bcfbc781363057ab95badb833cd9c987715e.name: Slash Command: /terminal-setup — Zed Keymap Not A List Text
1e92bcfbc781363057ab95badb833cd9c987715e.desc: Warning sentence when Zed keymap.json is not a readable list of keybindings.

6201090f1cd84d5a491c218ce2959160890137d6.name: Slash Command: /terminal-setup — Zed Keymap Backup Failed
6201090f1cd84d5a491c218ce2959160890137d6.desc: Assembled /terminal-setup warning when the keymap backup cannot be written, so the file is not modified.

00352ce15412c8619969e67463439d995af19d07.name: Slash Command: /terminal-setup — Zed Keymap Backup Failed Text
00352ce15412c8619969e67463439d995af19d07.desc: Warning sentence when /terminal-setup cannot back up Zed keymap.json and therefore refuses to edit it.

7578b06f9d42d0f76d68f6ee7c5fffd9c7ebb7f9.name: Slash Command: /terminal-setup — Zed Keymap Update Failed
7578b06f9d42d0f76d68f6ee7c5fffd9c7ebb7f9.desc: Assembled /terminal-setup warning when the edited keymap.json cannot be re-parsed as containing the binding.

83969c3f6ced36197ac4131ffe8e01314cbc394e.name: Slash Command: /terminal-setup — Zed Keymap Update Failed Text
83969c3f6ced36197ac4131ffe8e01314cbc394e.desc: Warning sentence when /terminal-setup cannot apply the Shift+Enter edit to Zed keymap.json.

f2f0583519605fc83128ade3d722f977017a0b5f.name: Tool Result: Git Bundle Gitattributes Symlink On Old Git
f2f0583519605fc83128ade3d722f977017a0b5f.desc: Bundle/dir-sync refusal detail when a committed .gitattributes is a symlink that old git follows, telling the model to update git and retry.

76fe261d6ba2a650d4adcf84b94597c74e33414a.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync Uncommitted Too Large Largest File
76fe261d6ba2a650d4adcf84b94597c74e33414a.desc: Inner branch of the dir-sync skip notice naming the per-message size cap and the largest file that blew it.

e7d56ac96e0f7658012f329264f58bf6b10624c9.name: Orphaned Background Agent (Resumable) Notice
e7d56ac96e0f7658012f329264f58bf6b10624c9.desc: Notification injected into model context on resume about a stopped-or-interrupted background agent whose transcript is resumable.

e800b8ffda4b234614eaaa378eea093ecc3edf79.name: Orphaned Agents Aggregate — Stopped
e800b8ffda4b234614eaaa378eea093ecc3edf79.desc: Aggregate system-reminder listing background agents from a previous session with no completion record (stopped variant), injected as a task-notification.

f32b2e6f093a368e12568bc5f842c6132568822b.name: Remote Tool: Unverified Refusal
f32b2e6f093a368e12568bc5f842c6132568822b.desc: Rebuilt served-call refusal content when the device's answer is below the attestation floor, telling the model to check effects before re-running.

62440300f89738ba3d964df6b115c17eff042a01.name: Remote Tool: Unverified Unrecognized Refusal
62440300f89738ba3d964df6b115c17eff042a01.desc: Same unverified-refusal tool result for a refusal code this session does not recognise.

b15d544bc224afcbe99ff26131479a110d6fa4e9.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Event Stream Not Accepting Clause
b15d544bc224afcbe99ff26131479a110d6fa4e9.desc: unreachable detail interpolated into the session-channel host_offline tool_result when the event stream is not accepting requests, so nothing was sent.

7691de8ca020a98042e9de99f57f16d23503b428.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Liveness Stream-Lost Clause
7691de8ca020a98042e9de99f57f16d23503b428.desc: unreachable detail interpolated into the session-channel host_offline tool_result when the liveness check failed because the event stream closed or the write was refused.

58b6736a170c86fda4dd4b8555b0ddcddc06ed59.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Withdrew During Probe Clause
58b6736a170c86fda4dd4b8555b0ddcddc06ed59.desc: unreachable detail interpolated into the session-channel host_offline tool_result when the machine withdrew while a liveness check was in flight.

984dbc278159d630720870446628662eef7fe5b4.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Liveness Unanswered Clause
984dbc278159d630720870446628662eef7fe5b4.desc: unreachable detail interpolated into the session-channel host_offline tool_result when the machine did not answer a liveness check.

e7c4a4b0819944238d85cfed0ff79b4193e6f00e.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Event Stream Closed Clause
e7c4a4b0819944238d85cfed0ff79b4193e6f00e.desc: unreachable detail interpolated into the session-channel host_offline tool_result when the event stream is closed, so the call was not sent.

b39680ab7e623d658a9b0152af8a0d65c3c71ac4.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Service Refused Clause
b39680ab7e623d658a9b0152af8a0d65c3c71ac4.desc: unreachable detail interpolated into the session-channel host_offline tool_result when the session service refused the request (optional HTTP status), so nothing was delivered.

c7c6338ed6406ab1d142f57ebc92ec8f9fc4c015.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Unknown — Respell
c7c6338ed6406ab1d142f57ebc92ec8f9fc4c015.desc: unknown_host tool_result when an attached machine matches ignoring case or an (offline) suffix, telling the model the exact lower-case name to use.

751355b9b624a3cb2cda9d76866ff3fff65f4472.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Unknown Offline Clause
751355b9b624a3cb2cda9d76866ff3fff65f4472.desc: Clause appended to the respell unknown_host tool_result when the matched name did not answer last time, so a retry may fail until it is reachable again.

e593977ce9606e773dd2ae20a9eeb72de759a670.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Bridge Unreachable And No Announce
e593977ce9606e773dd2ae20a9eeb72de759a670.desc: Clause in the not-reannounced host_offline tool_result naming a machine that could not be reached through the device bridge and whose Claude Code did not announce tools.

76ed8e15ae81146704a38828cb57e7c1bc294a4b.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Offline Reasons
76ed8e15ae81146704a38828cb57e7c1bc294a4b.desc: Shared reasons clause interpolated into bound-machine-not-connected and not-reannounced host_offline tool_results (asleep, offline, not running, serving off, or unverified).

8744dd6ee5fda61c59bc599092158a6503a34bf1.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Serves Nothing
8744dd6ee5fda61c59bc599092158a6503a34bf1.desc: host_offline tool_result when the attached machine last announced it serves no tools, so the named tool cannot run and nothing was sent.

10b732a32e94fdb41abfac7fe35f6a1e551bcaf9.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Bound Machine Not Connected
10b732a32e94fdb41abfac7fe35f6a1e551bcaf9.desc: host_offline tool_result when a machine is bound but its Claude Code has not connected, telling the model to ask the user to check that machine.

6f4d708fa61b8fe61db2cbae8d8ee8bc5942cfb8.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Session Unreachable
6f4d708fa61b8fe61db2cbae8d8ee8bc5942cfb8.desc: unreachable tool_result on the session channel: the named machine could not be reached (detail in parentheses), so the call did not run and an oversized payload will not succeed on retry.

9b2c6348a116a732cf40bf6438adb9cbc799d38b.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Unverified Refusal Unknown Run
9b2c6348a116a732cf40bf6438adb9cbc799d38b.desc: dropped tool_result when an unverified sender reported the call refused and the machine could not be asked what became of it, so the model must check before re-running.

dfdee7eb471a707bc48f202887d703fec09095e7.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Approval Unverified Not Received
dfdee7eb471a707bc48f202887d703fec09095e7.desc: Prefix of both the withdrawn-approval and withdrawn-race tool_results when an unverified sender reported the approval refused and the host had not received it when asked.

3e913881e0036b8019118e8e02ad4e43e20fce39.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Approval Withdrawn
3e913881e0036b8019118e8e02ad4e43e20fce39.desc: approval_not_received tool_result when the permission request was withdrawn on the host and nothing ran; retry is safe unless the refusal was unverified, in which case the user must re-approve from the terminal or desktop prompt.

27ddb60f4a5fac32a186698ac33a554bd24ff330.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Approval Withdrawn Unverified Surface
27ddb60f4a5fac32a186698ac33a554bd24ff330.desc: Inner instruction on the withdrawn-approval tool_result when the refusal was unverified: resend and have the user approve from the terminal or desktop prompt, unedited.

4bb9f3d9e38d0c860f9dbbdd5d5327910ad3ba71.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Approval Withdrawn Retry Safe
4bb9f3d9e38d0c860f9dbbdd5d5327910ad3ba71.desc: Inner sentence of the withdrawn-approval tool_result stating it is safe to retry the call if it is still wanted.

e5607702be8a9f6f1a0fdd907076a5710654e845.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Withdrew From Session
e5607702be8a9f6f1a0fdd907076a5710654e845.desc: Prefix of the host_gone/host_withdrawn tool_result when Claude Code on the machine withdrew (exited or stopped serving).

937a356065c6f48623dc3a473f71d62616165c35.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Gone Before Call
937a356065c6f48623dc3a473f71d62616165c35.desc: host_gone tool_result when the machine withdrew or restarted before the call reached it, so nothing ran and no result will arrive.

c653e0bb3db95e36e2fd4a44d966fd83c5392127.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Gone Mid Call
c653e0bb3db95e36e2fd4a44d966fd83c5392127.desc: host_gone tool_result when the machine withdrew or restarted while the call was with it; no result will arrive and the model must check effects before repeating.

6d73798a45a98029c66511249fea35882da3e751.name: Tool Hosts Notice: Session Host Missed Liveness
6d73798a45a98029c66511249fea35882da3e751.desc: Per-host tool_hosts_notice bullet when a session-channel machine did not answer a liveness check; the next call naming it checks again.

3b99a4dc6eb93134ea7597d68cdd64daf1590d29.name: Tool Hosts Notice: Host Re-announced By New Client
3b99a4dc6eb93134ea7597d68cdd64daf1590d29.desc: tool_hosts_notice bullet when a machine is now served by a different attached client than before, with the re-announce UTC time.

b278f2f55f399e5c6ade73c204571cb6392302e3.name: Tool Result: Remote Host Offline Liveness Clause
b278f2f55f399e5c6ade73c204571cb6392302e3.desc: Detail interpolated into the session-unreachable tool_result when a session-channel host is offline because it did not answer a liveness check.

030d15f0080cdf9a96e38fdac6ff88a9cca813d3.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync User Branch Followed
030d15f0080cdf9a96e38fdac6ff88a9cca813d3.desc: Tells the cloud agent the checkout followed the user's branch (or detached HEAD), including any previous tip kept under a ref.

0089d68d3d91a4702d0e30b2e78d5be87ff81847.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync From-Branch Stays Put
0089d68d3d91a4702d0e30b2e78d5be87ff81847.desc: Inner phrase of the user-branch-followed reminder naming the previous branch that stays where it was.

7a98481f2bf40dce47022e0ee168f4674ab90cd1.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync Agent Commits Carried Along
7a98481f2bf40dce47022e0ee168f4674ab90cd1.desc: Inner clause of the user-branch-followed reminder when kept agent commits were carried along so HEAD or the followed branch now points at the agent's tip.

a5b6e99c8566e086b86445b218fe89e771a5432a.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync Checkout Back On User Branch
a5b6e99c8566e086b86445b218fe89e771a5432a.desc: Agent-moved arm of the user-branch-followed reminder: this checkout is back on the user's HEAD or branch, which it follows at every turn.

a912d3c0e1a9070daaeef15a1492cd522d97c83a.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync Had Switched To From-Branch
a912d3c0e1a9070daaeef15a1492cd522d97c83a.desc: Inner phrase of the agent-moved arm: the checkout had switched to the from-branch, which stays where it was.

c9b61122ec463324ac3d256010969cdecdf06c8b.name: System Reminder: Dir Sync User Switched Checkout Followed
c9b61122ec463324ac3d256010969cdecdf06c8b.desc: User-moved arm of the user-branch-followed reminder: the user switched branch and this checkout followed.

570cf0d92f1db5ebff9edada2e4796966ac51466.name: Tool Result: Remote-tool unverified refusal reason - session not bound to that machine
570cf0d92f1db5ebff9edada2e4796966ac51466.desc: Reason clause for an unverified-sender remote-tool refusal: this session is not bound to the target machine.

6e13efd90dfb8bc363c3c0038b794a7d77a9797e.name: Tool Result: Remote-tool unverified refusal reason - protocol version not accepted
6e13efd90dfb8bc363c3c0038b794a7d77a9797e.desc: Reason clause for an unverified-sender remote-tool refusal: the call's protocol version was rejected.

3070b67c47d61a65e4dc094eb122be6154f71acc.name: Tool Result: Remote-tool unverified refusal reason - call not acceptable as sent
3070b67c47d61a65e4dc094eb122be6154f71acc.desc: Reason clause for an unverified-sender remote-tool refusal: the request itself was malformed or unacceptable.

873e81f415e208a88510c703b2f88b646d88674c.name: Tool Result: Remote-tool unverified refusal reason - tool not served to this session
873e81f415e208a88510c703b2f88b646d88674c.desc: Reason clause for an unverified-sender remote-tool refusal: the target machine does not expose this tool to the session.

497c847b27f4d019d7e0105b16954bd383c8f4ea.name: Tool Result: Remote-tool unverified refusal reason - session could not be identified
497c847b27f4d019d7e0105b16954bd383c8f4ea.desc: Reason clause for an unverified-sender remote-tool refusal: the target could not attribute the call to a session.

8f60cd831602a59f533b23b4aabe685ee3dbc6a5.name: Tool Result: Remote-tool unverified refusal reason - machine bound to a different session
8f60cd831602a59f533b23b4aabe685ee3dbc6a5.desc: Reason clause for an unverified-sender remote-tool refusal: the target is connected for another session.

a20abe04e6fc044434b0b8fabea6961df63729fc.name: Tool Result: Remote-tool unverified refusal reason - concurrency limit reached
a20abe04e6fc044434b0b8fabea6961df63729fc.desc: Reason clause for an unverified-sender remote-tool refusal: the target is already at its in-flight call limit.

e935f62afe8f557d044d39aa05f39f445a506e50.name: Tool Result: Remote-tool unverified refusal reason - input field not accepted
e935f62afe8f557d044d39aa05f39f445a506e50.desc: Reason clause for an unverified-sender remote-tool refusal: one input field is rejected by the target machine.

acc398e150cba3d79c1ab98fafbfcff2e15ea078.name: Tool Result: Remote-tool unverified refusal reason - sandbox off or not confining
acc398e150cba3d79c1ab98fafbfcff2e15ea078.desc: Reason clause for an unverified-sender remote-tool refusal: the target serves no tools while its sandbox is off or partial.

0a0f746fba4080c7f7b71008c1cc23da187d5d4e.name: Tool Result: Remote-tool unverified refusal reason - no record of the call
0a0f746fba4080c7f7b71008c1cc23da187d5d4e.desc: Reason clause for an unverified-sender remote-tool refusal: the target has no record of the referenced call.

1ba6bf11e4df1634998d8c37cb71be2e51cd1823.name: Slash Command: /mcp — reconnect after auth failed, with reason
1ba6bf11e4df1634998d8c37cb71be2e51cd1823.desc: Reports that the post-authentication reconnect failed and carries the sanitized failure reason so the model can tell the user what went wrong.

43bd89635ec5850193d6245d89d9284ba1326ec6.name: Slash Command: /mcp — new credentials rejected on reconnect
43bd89635ec5850193d6245d89d9284ba1326ec6.desc: Tells the model the fresh OAuth tokens were refused by the server and gives two recovery paths (re-authenticate, or restart), so it does not loop on the same flow.

4b01689d712f85ce115c4502798ed6a140aded86.name: Slash Command: /mcp — agent server authenticated, connects on next run
